title: Fridge Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Refrigerator compartment sensor open or shorted.
fullDescription: Thermistor reading out of range; cooling control degraded.

faq.a: Move to cooler if temp rises.

title: Defrost Sensor Fault
fullDescription: Cannot detect coil temp during defrost.

title: Defrost Heater Fault
fullDescription: Element burned out or thermal fuse blown.

title: Evap Fan Fault
fullDescription: Fan blade frozen or motor failed.

title: High Humidity Alert
fullDescription: Door left open or bad seal.

fixSteps.title: Check seal
fixSteps.instruction: Paper test door gasket; replace if loose.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Display lost contact with main board.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Open control panel and reseat ribbon.

title: Voltage Error
fullDescription: Inverter compressor needs stable line voltage.
